															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

						About BTSC Lab Technician, OT Assistant, ECG Technician, X-Ray Technician & SMO Recruitment 2025

						BTSC Recruitment 2025: Healthcare Careers Beckon with 9757 Openings
						The Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) is offering a golden opportunity for aspiring healthcare professionals with its 2025 recruitment drive. With a combined total of 9757 vacancies for Lab Technicians, OT Assistants, ECG Technicians,X-Ray Technicians & Specialist Medical Officer (SMO), this is a significant step towards bolstering Bihar's healthcare sector.

						Key Dates to Note:

						The online application process commences on March 4th, 2025, and concludes on April 1st, 2025. Ensure your application and fee payment are completed within this timeframe. The examination date will be announced later.

						Application Fees and Payment:

						General, BC, EBC, EWS, and other state candidates will need to pay Rs. 600. However, SC/ST/EBC candidates from Bihar, and all female candidates from Bihar, benefit from a reduced fee of Rs. 150. Payments can be made conveniently through Credit Card, Debit Card, or Net Banking.

						Age Criteria and Relaxation:

						As of August 1st, 2024, the minimum age requirement is 21 years. The maximum age varies by category: 37 years for UR (Male), 40 years for UR (Female) and BC/EBC (Male & Female), and 42 years for SC/ST (Male & Female). For detailed age relaxation specifics, refer to the official notification.

						Post-Wise Vacancy Details:

						Lab Technician (Advt.No 02/2025): 2969 Posts
						OT Assistant (Advt.No 03/2025): 1683 Posts
						ECG Technician (Advt.No 04/2025): 242 Posts
						X-Ray Technician (Advt.No 05/2025): 1240 Posts

						Specialist Medical Officer (SMO) (Advt.No 06/2025 to 18/2025): 3623 Posts

						
						This recruitment provides a fantastic chance to contribute to Bihar's healthcare system. If you are qualified and passionate about healthcare, don't miss this opportunity. Always refer to the official BTSC website for the most accurate and current information.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

						BTSC Recruitment 2025: Healthcare Careers Beckon with 9757 Openings
						The Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC) is offering a golden opportunity for aspiring healthcare professionals with its 2025 recruitment drive. 						Age Criteria and Relaxation:

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. 															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															Education Qualification

															
																(i) Passed Intermediate / 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
																(ii) Must have passed a Laboratory Technician Diploma Course / Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) course from an institution recognized by the Central Government, Bihar Government, or any other State Government, along with the relevant certificate.
															

															

															
																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. 																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

																Specialist Medical Officer (SMO):- 
															

															(i) A candidate must possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate degree/diploma (or equivalent qualification) in related Field/ Trade from a recognized Indian university approved by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or the National Medical Commission (NMC), as specified under the Bihar and Odisha Medical Act, 1916.

															If the degree is obtained from a foreign university, the candidate must have completed a 4-year MBBS course along with a 1-year rotating internship and must have passed the FMGE (Foreign Medical Graduate Examination) conducted by the MCI. The degree will only be considered valid if recognized by the MCI.

															Additionally, for postgraduate qualifications (MD/MS/DM/MCh) that require a rotating internship, if the internship is completed in the same year and the degree is recognized by the MCI, the candidate will be considered eligible for the position of Dermatologist.

															(ii) Mandatory Experience:
															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government. Permanent registration with the Medical Council is mandatory, regardless of the reason.

															The candidate must have completed a 12-month compulsory rotating internship from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India and the government.
